prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE English Patterns learning atlas.
Pattern context: subject + verb + at night / At night, + clause. Style: Photorealistic everyday editorial photography, warm natural light, coherent with the existing learning atlases.
Canvas width:height MUST be THREE:FOUR (0.75), not 1:2. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of SQUARE photographic cells, with narrow continuous pure white divider gutters. All twelve cells visible. Final display contract 1536x2048.
Conservative Arab Muslim family learning contexts. Men wear loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck shirts and full-length trousers or thobes. Women wear loose opaque full-coverage clothing and hijab. Apply modest clothing to background people too.
No bare torso, shoulders, midriff or thighs, tight or transparent clothes, revealing nightwear, swimwear, underwear, changing, bathing, showering, intimate or romantic poses, kissing or inappropriate physical contact.
Water and beach contexts use fully clothed people on a dry shore, promenade or empty poolside. Never show swimmers, sunbathers, mixed bathing or distant revealing figures. Depict swimming discussions before the activity, with equipment where useful.
No alcohol, gambling, nightclub setting, graphic injury, active weapon violence, or religious caricatures. Use ordinary respectful Arab settings without adding religious rituals unrelated to the sentence.
Preserve the exact English sentence and Arabic meaning. Adapt only the visual staging. If a compliant scene cannot convey the meaning honestly, hold the cell for review instead of substituting an unrelated picture.
No captions, words, numbers, logos, speech/thought bubbles, graphic overlays or floating inset pictures. Physical analog clocks can use hands and tick marks for time examples.
Exactly three columns and four rows in row-major order, twelve square cells, portrait 3:4, final atlas 1536x2048, 512x512 per cell with 40px safe inset and continuous straight white dividers. Measure actual source gutters before preparing the display atlas.
The following English sentences are context only: do not render their text. Exact panel order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Meaning: At night, I read a short story. Visual staging: A realistic nighttime setting lit by warm lamps. Specific context: At night, I read a short story. No captions or written speech.
2. Meaning: I brush my teeth at night. Visual staging: A realistic nighttime setting lit by warm lamps. Specific context: I brush my teeth at night. No captions or written speech.
3. Meaning: At night, the street is quiet. Visual staging: A realistic nighttime setting lit by warm lamps. Specific context: At night, the street is quiet. No captions or written speech.
4. Meaning: I turn off my phone at night. Visual staging: A realistic nighttime setting lit by warm lamps. Specific context: I turn off my phone at night. No captions or written speech.
5. Meaning: I keep a glass of water beside my bed at night. Visual staging: A glass of water on a bedside table in a softly lit bedroom. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
6. Meaning: The city looks different at night. Visual staging: A city street illuminated by evening lights.
7. Meaning: I close the curtains at night. Visual staging: An adult closing bedroom curtains after dark. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
8. Meaning: My brother works at night and sleeps during the day. Visual staging: An adult worker at a night shift workstation.
9. Meaning: I listen to quiet music at night. Visual staging: An adult relaxing with headphones beside a dim lamp.
10. Meaning: The buses run less often at night. Visual staging: A quiet bus stop with a single waiting passenger after dark.
11. Meaning: We can see the stars at night when the sky is clear. Visual staging: Two adults looking at a clear starry sky.
12. Meaning: I put my phone away at night so that I can rest. Visual staging: An adult putting a phone in a drawer before resting in bed. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.


The reference image is ONLY for regular square-cell grid geometry and photographic realism. Replace ALL breakfast scenes with these nighttime settings, each of the twelve images distinctly separate. Preserve exact THREE columns and FOUR rows, equal SQUARE panels, overall THREE:FOUR portrait ratio, and continuous straight narrow white gutters. Concrete staging: 1 an Arab man in a loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck thobe seated in an armchair reading a short story book beside a warm lamp, black night window; 2 fully clothed hijab-wearing woman brushing teeth at a sink with dark window, no shower/bath/changing; 3 quiet empty residential street at night with real streetlights, no people needed; 4 man in full opaque clothing switching off his phone, its screen becoming black, dark window; 5 close view of a clear glass of water beside a modest neatly covered bed and bedside lamp, no person needed; 6 a lively city avenue illuminated by real lights after dark, no readable shop signs; 7 fully covered woman in loose long sleeves and opaque hijab closing bedroom curtains, no exposed body; 8 fully clothed male night-shift worker at a workstation, dark outside window, not sleeping; 9 fully clothed man relaxing in a chair wearing headphones by a dim lamp; 10 a quiet bus stop at night with a single fully covered waiting passenger and a distant bus, no legible timetable; 11 two fully clothed male friends standing on a safe open terrace looking up at real stars in a clear dark sky, no romantic scene or gesture; 12 fully clothed woman in opaque hijab placing her phone into a bedside drawer before resting, no changing or undressing, bed opaque and neat. All foreground/background people fully covered in loose opaque high-neck long sleeves and full-length garments. No readable text, numbers, labels, logos, illustrated notes, floating images or graphic sound lines. Important objects stay safely inside each square panel. Do NOT output a narrow1:2 canvas.
